name: find-free-time
description: Finds up to 20 free intervals in an Outlook calendar during requested working hours. Read-only. Each slot is { start, end, timeZone: "UTC" }; start and end are UTC date-times without an offset or milliseconds and can be passed directly to microsoft-outlook__create-event.

start.description: Start of the search window as an ISO 8601 date-time with a UTC offset.

end.description: End of the search window as an ISO 8601 date-time with a UTC offset.

durationMinutes.description: Minimum free interval length in minutes.

workdayStartHour.description: Start hour of each workday in the specified fixed UTC offset.

workdayEndHour.description: End hour of each workday in the specified fixed UTC offset.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Fixed offset from UTC, in minutes, used to interpret working hours and weekdays; from -720 (UTC-12) to 840 (UTC+14).

includeWeekends.description: Whether Saturday and Sunday are included as working days.
